node.title: Re^3: Script to compare 2 folders, including sub folders and files with content
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [karthik.raju],

I suggest you re-read the documentation of [doc://File::DirCompare] closely, as it gives examples of the correct syntax with which to supply options: they are supplied as a hash reference ({ matches => ... }) as the last argument to the compare function. If you still have trouble please see [id://174051] and show the exact error messages and the code needed to reproduce them.

Regards,
-- Hauke D
